scenes.heading: CI/CD Fundamentals
scenes.narration: Continuous integration and continuous delivery automate the path from a code commit all the way to a running release.

scenes.heading: CI versus CD
bullets: CI: merge, build, and test every change
Every commit produces a versioned artifact
scenes.narration: Continuous integration means every change is merged, built, and tested automatically, so problems surface immediately. Continuous delivery takes those passing builds and moves them toward release without manual toil. This fast feedback loop catches bugs early when they are cheap to fix, and each commit produces a versioned, deployable artifact.

scenes.heading: A typical pipeline
scenes.narration: The pipeline begins when a developer pushes a commit. It first lints and runs the test suite to verify correctness. If the tests pass, it builds a container image and pushes that image to the registry as a versioned artifact. Finally it deploys that artifact to the target environment automatically.

scenes.heading: A GitHub Actions workflow
scenes.code:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest -q
scenes.narration: This workflow triggers on every push to the main branch. It checks out the repository and sets up the correct Python version. It then installs the project dependencies and runs the test suite with pytest. If any step fails, the whole run is marked red, blocking the change from progressing further down the pipeline.

scenes.heading: Manual releases vs CI/CD
scenes.narration: Manual releases depend on a person remembering and running each step, which produces inconsistent, slow, and error-prone results. A CI/CD pipeline runs the identical steps every single time, giving you repeatable, audited, and reliable releases.

scenes.text: CI/CD turns every commit into a tested, versioned artifact and a repeatable path to production.
scenes.narration: The heart of CI/CD is that every commit becomes a tested, versioned artifact travelling a repeatable path to production.
